notes: Canonical grow rates for living-shell bakes. SimpleAI = eco sprawl; BARb = fortify/teeth after strip. Peaceful co-grow shares AllyTeams. Battle-farm recipes (recipeKind=battle_farm) set peacefulCoGrow=false for real 1v1/3v3 war mids. SIMS always use normal commanders; after strip, occupation plants decoy commanders (armdecom/cordecom/legdecom) as Armada autonomous eco-farm swarm — weaker, less metal, on-brand.

occupation.notes: Decoy coms farm solar/converter fiction without real-com danger or D-gun economy rewards.

sprawl.label: SimpleAI eco sprawl
sprawl.useWhen: Converter utopia, energy islands, soft occupation (Greenest default).

fortify_easy.label: BARb easy fortify
fortify_easy.useWhen: Light teeth without deathball (Greenest secondary islands).

fortify.label: BARb medium fortify
fortify.useWhen: Lane teeth, gatefields, ridge forts (Koom scar, Tabula gates).

fortify_hard.label: BARb hard fortress
fortify_hard.useWhen: Citadel spine, Cortex dealer core, plateau fortress.

aggressive_core.label: BARb hard_aggressive core
aggressive_core.useWhen: High-pressure faction cores that should feel military after strip (ATS Cortex basin optional).

scrap.label: Thin scrap foothold
scrap.useWhen: Null scrap only (Rock Jungle, thin Null footholds).

thin.label: Thin edge / glass / killfield
thin.useWhen: Glassed center edge, scar mouth, central killfield — never a city.
